scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vite build --config vite.main.config.ts
scripts.package:win: corepack pnpm prepare:tools && corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.package:smoke: corepack pnpm package:win && node scripts/smoke.mjs release/HoneyBee-win32-x64/HoneyBee.exe
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit --pretty false
